role: Plain value types carrying last night's sleep and multi-night sleep trend into AnalysisSummaryGenerator; built from SleepData / SleepTrendStats, the trend from the archived nights before a session (AnalysisSleepTrendInput.recentNights).
types: AnalysisSleepInput: struct — one night's sleep minutes/stages/efficiency plus short/good/fragmented gates against HRVThresholds
AnalysisSleepTrendInput: struct — averaged sleep trend over N nights

AnalysisSleepTrendInput.SleepTrend: typealias of SleepTrendStats.SleepTrend (improving/declining/stable/insufficient; rawValue of insufficient is "insufficient data", which no reader of this type uses)
toplevel: Two static `empty` instances built via the memberwise inits (AnalysisSleepInputs.swift:36-40, 76-79).

units.does: True when the night has some sleep but fewer than HRVThresholds.sleepShortMinutes (300) minutes; a 0-minute (no data) night is not short.
Memberwise initializer storing the six sleep fields; used to build `.empty`.

Builds the input from a HealthKit-resolved SleepData: total = nightSleepMinutes (nap excluded), inBed, deep, rem, awake, and measuredSleepEfficiency (nil when wake unmeasured). Called from MorningResultsViewModel.swift:312.

branches.effect: true: self = .empty (all zeros/nil) and return; false: copy fields from the SleepData

units.does: Memberwise initializer for the trend input; used to build `.empty`.
Builds the trend input from HealthKitManager.SleepTrendStats (averages, nightsAnalyzed) and copies its trend directly (SleepTrend is the same enum). Called from MorningResultsViewModel.swift:313.

branches.effect: true: self = .empty (0 avg, trend .insufficient, 0 nights); false: copy fields

units.does: AnalysisSleepTrendInput from SleepTrendStats.recentNights(before:in:) for the session, or nil when there is no session or no prior night with measured sleep.
units.entry: Called by AssistantContextSource.build, ContextBuilder.yesterdayDiagnostic and ReportRenderer.recoveryPDFURL.

branches.cond: session nil or no prior night
